title: Railway NFR Apprentice Online Form 2026 (6777 Posts)
vacancyDetails: 6777 Act Apprentice training slots across NFR divisions and workshops (Assam, West Bengal, Bihar) for 2025-26 & 2026-27 cycles
qualification: Class 10 with minimum 50% marks and ITI / NCVT certificate in relevant trade
ageLimit: 15 to 24 years (relaxations as per Apprentices Act / railway rules)
selectionProcess: Merit based on 10th + ITI marks → Document Verification → Medical / Engagement
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit NFR Indian Railways official section / apprenticeship portal
2. Open Act Apprentice 2026 apply online
3. Register and select trade/unit preference
4. Upload 10th, ITI certificates and photo
5. Submit between 20 July and ~19-20 August 2026
shortDescription: NFR Railway Act Apprentice Online Form 2026 for 6777 slots. Apply ~20 July – 20 August 2026. 10th + ITI required.
content:
Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) has released centralized notification for 6,777 Act Apprentice seats under Apprentices Act 1961.

Apply online from about 20 July 2026 (till mid/late August 2026 as per notice). Eligibility: Matric with 50% + ITI in notified trade. Age typically 15–24 years.
